name: js-ts-frontend
body: The unified JS/TS frontend: the TypeScript compiler API over .ts/.tsx plus .js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs via allowJs, with CJS/ESM/package.json module resolution, jsx, and JSDoc checking where present. Ported from scanner.mjs to a built scanner.ts. Exact where the checker resolves; unresolved dynamic JavaScript yields UnresolvedTarget. Source is src/tslib/scanner.mjs + src/tslib/package.json, which are not yet in the scanned graph (plain ESM, no build step) — the plan declares the ported source as planned Implementation nodes, and this component's `implemented-by` anchors are the planned `ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.collectFile` and `ts.apg-tsfrontend.scanner.emitNode` (graded Pending by `classify_code_ref` until the branch re-scan realizes them).
